dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: This is the Palais Mermonia, where all official affairs are handled and public services are rendered.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: And, of course, it is where Iudex Neuvillette has his office.

dialogues.speaker: Bruneau
dialogues.text: If you have any questions about Fontaine's public affairs, this is where you come to ask. But do follow the rules, please. There will be consequences if you cause any trouble.
